title: Riley — quant eval daylog
content:
DAYLOG: quick brain dump and run notes (informal)

Date: 2026-03-05 (last update)
Context: working on 4-bit/3-bit quant profiles for gptx-3b variants; focus on latency SLOs for low-latency chat and keeping quality regression under 2% (measured on conversational-cases-v2 eval set).

Top-of-mind TODOs:
- finish bullseye run comparing 4-bit q5_0 vs q4_0 (small sample) across 3 prompt families
- measure kv-cache warmup penalty with prefix-caching enabled (cold vs warm)
- try per-layer quant scale on attention matrices (idea from convo w/ Evelyn)
- add simple eval wrapper to post metrics to /optimize/rollups (script)

Quick hypotheses:
- 4-bit q4_0 with per-head scale will keep BLEU/ROUGE-like scores within 1.5% of fp16 for short-turn dialog, but will reduce peak memory by ~35%.
- Batch size 8 -> throughput up but latency p95 will blow past SLO for single-turn chat; need smart batching policy.

Command snippets I used:
- run locally: ./run_eval.sh --model redwood/gptx-3b --quant q4_0 --eval-set conversational-cases-v2 --batch 1 --kv-cache true --out ./out/q4_0_run1.json
- perf profiling: python perf/trace_tokens.py --pid $PID --interval 0.02 --log out/trace-q4_0.tsv
- small server: docker run --gpus all -e MODEL=redwood/gptx-3b --entrypoint /serve/bin/start quant-test:latest

Experimental notes (raw):
- run q4_0, batch1, kv-cache enabled
  * avg latency (single-turn): 72ms
  * p95: 130ms (bad)
  * tokens/sec: 340
  * GPU mem peak: 5.1GB
  * eval-acc (conv-cases v2): 0.882 vs fp16 baseline 0.895 -> -1.4%
  * weird: occasional token hangs at step ~120 (trace shows lock contention in batching module)

- run q5_0, batch1, kv-cache enabled
  * avg latency: 95ms
  * p95: 180ms
  * tokens/sec: 280
  * mem: 6.6GB
  * eval-acc: 0.890 -> -0.6%

Observations:
- q4_0 is promising for mem + throughput, but p95 latency needs attention. Suspect batching and attention kernel selection for short sequences.
- KV-cache warmup: first request after model load is ~2.3x slower; prefix caching reduces that to ~1.15x. Need to instrument the router to pre-warm common prefixes for chat templates.

Prompt sets used (copied here so they dont get lost):
- chat-short: ["Hey, summarize this: {context}", "What is the main point?"]
- instruction-step: ["List steps to accomplish: {task}", "Explain simply"]
- multi-turn-qa: (3-turn convo with clarifying Qs) -> see conversational-cases-v2 subset A

Quick prompt templates (for reproducibility):
- SHORT_SUMMARY:
  """You are a helpful assistant. Summarize the following in 1-2 sentences:
  {context}
  """
- STEP_BY_STEP:
  """You are an expert. Provide numbered steps for: {task}. Keep it under 200 words."""

Rough eval plan (next week):
- run full sweep: quant in [q4_0, q5_0, q3_0-prototype] x batch in [1,4,8] x kv-cache [on, off]
- capture metrics: latency p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, gpu-mem, eval-accuracy, hallucination-rate (simple keyword checks)
- compare vs baseline fp16 pinned model and produce a short slide for PD sync

Open questions / decisions:
- accept q4_0 if eval-acc drop <= 2% and p95 <= 150ms? (Draft SLO threshold)
- do we prioritize mem savings (for Dedicated slot density) vs guaranteed latency (hosted API)? Need product input.

Small debugging checklist (for the token hangs):
- repro with --trace-batching and capture logs
- try disabling continuous batching in runtime and measure p95
- run in SRE staging with tracing enabled (see LNR-2241)

Notes-to-self:
- mention this cold/warm kv-cache behavior on PR commentary for serve/pull/812
- follow up with Evelyn about per-layer scale experiments (she suggested a simple schedule: freeze heads -> collect hist -> fit scales)

Sentences to salvage into PR description later:
- "Empirical runs indicate q4_0 provides the best memory/throughput tradeoff for short-turn chat with acceptable quality regression when combined with prefix caching."

Random todo (low priority):
- try static 8-bit matmul for attention only (combine with 4-bit weights)
- collect user-facing latency percentiles from prod traces (ask observability team for 30d window)

End of dump. This is messy — keep iterating.

Links / refs I referenced:
- GH run: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serve/pull/812
- Linear ticket: LNR-2241
- Eval set: s3://redwood-evals/conversational-cases-v2/subsetA.json
